content_sections.heading: MRPL Assistant Engineer Pay Scale 2026
content_sections.text: In addition to basic pay, selected candidates get DA (IDA pattern), HRA/Township accommodation, Perks & Allowances under cafeteria approach, Performance Related Pay, and other benefits as per Company Rules. Candidates will be placed on training-cum-probation as per Company Rules. Selected candidates must serve MRPL for a minimum of 3 years from date of joining (including training-cum-probation).

content_sections.heading: MRPL Assistant Engineer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Initial shortlisting is based purely on valid GATE-2026 marks (out of 100) ; marks from any previous/other GATE examination are not considered. Shortlisted candidates are called for Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) in the ratio of 1:5 (1 post : 5 candidates), category/reservation-wise. In case of a tie in GATE marks, the candidate with higher marks in the essential qualification (degree) will be ranked higher. The final merit list is prepared as per MRPL's prevailing rules; MRPL reserves the right to add, modify or delete any test in the selection process. Document Verification is conducted at the time of Personal Interview. A panel of suitable candidates may be created and kept valid for one year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MRPL Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit www.mrpl.co.in/careers and click on "Advt. No. 94/2026: Recruitment of Assistant Engineers in 'E2' Grade of Management Cadre through GATE 2026". Click "Click here to register online" to generate your Login ID and Password using a valid email ID and mobile number (must remain active for at least 1 year). Sign in and fill in educational qualification, category, and other required details in the online application form; an Application ID will be generated and sent via email/SMS. General/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates: click "Pay Now", select "Advt. 94/2026", and pay the application fee of ₹118/- online; save the payment receipt. After payment, return to the home page, click "Already Paid", sign in, and enter the SBI e-Collect Reference Number, bank name and payment date; upload the payment receipt (JPG). SC/ST/PwBD/ESM candidates (fee-exempt) can directly proceed to document upload. Upload scanned photograph, signature, GATE-2026 score card, and category/PwBD/EWS certificate as applicable, then click "Submit". Save the PDF of the submitted online application for your records – no printout needs to be sent to MRPL, unless forwarding through proper channel (see below). Important: Government/PSU/Autonomous body employees must either forward their printed application through Proper Channel or produce an NOC at the time of interview. Applications forwarded through proper channel should be sent to: Senior Manager (HR), Recruitment Section, Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited, Kuthethoor Post, Mangalore – 575030, Karnataka.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (at Document Verification / Interview)
content_sections.text: Proof of age: SSLC marks card / Matriculation certificate / School leaving certificate / Municipal or Gram Panchayat birth certificate All mark sheets and certificates for Class X, XII, Diploma, and Degree/PG Degree (individual semester/year mark sheets required) GATE-2026 Score Card showing marks scored out of 100 Caste certificate [SC/ST/OBC(NCL)] or Income & Asset Certificate (EWS), as applicable PwBD certificate (minimum 40% disability), where applicable Ex-servicemen status proof, where applicable No Objection Certificate (NOC) or proper-channel forwarding, for Government/PSU/Autonomous body employees Recent passport-size photograph and signature (scanned copies for online upload)

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidates called for GD/PI will be reimbursed travelling expenses (3AC train fare or AC bus fare limited to 3AC fare) by the shortest route; local travel cost is borne by the candidate. PwBD candidates get reimbursement for one attendant as per Government guidelines. Working knowledge of Hindi is desirable. Only one online application should be submitted; if multiple applications are received, the latest one submitted within the stipulated time is considered. Request for change of category or registered mobile/email, once submitted, will not be entertained. Selected candidates are liable to be transferred anywhere in India or abroad, within MRPL, ONGC group companies, or as per MRPL's requirement, and may need to work in shifts including night shifts. Application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances. Any legal dispute arising from this recruitment falls within the exclusive jurisdiction of courts at Mangalore. Any canvassing, directly or indirectly, will result in disqualification. MRPL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify or alter the recruitment process at any stage, without prior notice. For recruitment process queries, candidates can email [email protected] ; no other mode of communication will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Engineer posts has MRPL notified in 2026?
faq.answer: MRPL has notified 26 posts – 8 Mechanical, 3 Electrical, and 15 Chemical – under Advertisement No. 94/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MRPL Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online applications close on 19 September 2026 at 18:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. Are Mechanical and Electrical posts open to all categories?
faq.answer: No, these two disciplines are notified exclusively under a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates; only Chemical discipline posts are open to UR/EWS candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MRPL Assistant Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Maximum 27 years for UR/EWS as on 19 September 2026, with 3 years relaxation for OBC(NCL), 5 years for SC/ST, and an additional 10 years for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for MRPL Assistant Engineer (E2 Grade)?
faq.answer: Starting basic pay of ₹50,000/- in the scale of ₹50,000–₹1,60,000, plus DA, HRA/Township accommodation, and other perks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for MRPL Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on valid GATE-2026 marks, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for MRPL Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹118/- for General, OBC(NCL) and EWS candidates; SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a service bond for MRPL Assistant Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates must serve MRPL for a minimum of 3 years, executing a bond of ₹3,00,000 (General) or ₹50,000 (EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD).
